columns.name: schema_version
columns.description: Schema version of this event.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.description: Operation time as an RFC 3339 timestamp with a UTC offset.

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: Unique event identifier; used to deduplicate replayed events.

columns.name: event_outcome
columns.description: Operation outcome. blocked means a policy stopped the operation.

columns.name: gen_ai_operation_name
columns.description: Operation name. Well-known values include chat, generate_content, text_completion, embeddings, retrieval, execute_tool, invoke_agent, create_agent and invoke_workflow.

columns.name: gen_ai_conversation_id
columns.description: Conversation or session identifier, unique within the tenant.

columns.name: gen_ai_provider_name
columns.description: Model provider, for example openai, anthropic or aws.bedrock.

columns.name: gen_ai_request_model
columns.description: Requested model name.

columns.name: gen_ai_response_model
columns.description: Model that produced the response.

columns.name: service_name
columns.description: Name of the LLM application or gateway.

columns.name: deployment_environment_name
columns.description: Deployment environment, for example production or staging.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Pseudonymous principal identifier, unique within the tenant.

columns.name: user_roles
columns.description: Roles or authorization groups of the principal.

columns.name: user_tenant_id
columns.description: Tenant or organization identifier. Every correlation groups by it.

columns.name: api_key_id
columns.description: Opaque or hashed API key identifier. Never the key itself.

columns.name: client_address
columns.description: Address of the client that called the gateway.

columns.name: user_agent_original
columns.description: Client user agent.

columns.name: http_request_id
columns.description: Request identifier for correlation with upstream HTTP logs.

columns.name: gen_ai_usage_input_tokens
columns.description: Input tokens consumed.

columns.name: gen_ai_usage_output_tokens
columns.description: Output tokens produced.

columns.name: gen_ai_usage_reasoning_output_tokens
columns.description: Reasoning tokens, when the provider reports them.

columns.name: usage_total_tokens
columns.description: Input plus output tokens.

columns.name: gen_ai_request_temperature
columns.description: Requested sampling temperature.

columns.name: gen_ai_request_top_p
columns.description: Requested nucleus-sampling probability.

columns.name: gen_ai_request_max_tokens
columns.description: Requested maximum output tokens.

columns.name: gen_ai_request_choice_count
columns.description: Requested number of candidate completions.

columns.name: gen_ai_response_finish_reasons
columns.description: Finish reason per choice, for example stop, length, tool_calls or content_filter.

columns.name: cost_usd
columns.description: Gateway-computed cost of the operation in US dollars.

columns.name: error_type
columns.description: Low-cardinality error class when the operation failed.

columns.name: guardrail_input_flagged
columns.description: An input guardrail flagged the request.

columns.name: guardrail_input_categories
columns.description: Input guardrail categories, for example injection or pii.

columns.name: guardrail_output_flagged
columns.description: An output guardrail flagged the response.

columns.name: guardrail_output_categories
columns.description: Output guardrail categories.

columns.name: policy_decision
columns.description: Gateway policy decision for the operation.

columns.name: gen_ai_data_source_id
columns.description: Identifier of the data source used for retrieval.

columns.name: rag_retrieved_count
columns.description: Number of retrieved chunks added to the model context.

columns.name: rag_source_types
columns.description: Types of the retrieved sources, for example web, email, file, ticket or db.

columns.name: gen_ai_agent_id
columns.description: Agent identifier.

columns.name: gen_ai_agent_name
columns.description: Agent name.

columns.name: gen_ai_tool_name
columns.description: Name of the invoked tool.

columns.name: gen_ai_tool_call_id
columns.description: Tool call identifier.

columns.name: gen_ai_tool_type
columns.description: Tool type, for example function, extension or datastore.

columns.name: gen_ai_tool_call_arguments
columns.description: Arguments passed to the tool.

columns.name: gen_ai_tool_call_result
columns.description: Result returned by the tool.

columns.name: tool_call_depth
columns.description: Position of this call in the current tool chain.

columns.name: tool_call_chain
columns.description: Names of the tools invoked so far in this turn, in order.

columns.name: tool_call_outcome
columns.description: Outcome of the tool call. denied means an authorization policy refused it.

columns.name: output_sink
columns.description: Downstream consumer that received the model output.

columns.name: output_rendered_unsanitized
columns.description: The output reached its sink without sanitization or escaping.

columns.name: gen_ai_system_instructions
columns.description: System instructions supplied to the model.

columns.name: gen_ai_input_messages
columns.description: Input messages in the OpenTelemetry message format: {role, parts}.

columns.name: gen_ai_output_messages
columns.description: Output messages in the OpenTelemetry message format: {role, parts, finish_reason}.

columns.name: content_input_injection_markers
columns.description: Number of prompt-injection or instruction-extraction markers a detector found in the input.

columns.name: content_output_contains_system_prompt
columns.description: A detector found system-instruction content in the output.

columns.name: content_output_pii_types
columns.description: Personal-data classes a detector found in the output, for example email, phone or ssn.

columns.name: content_output_secret_types
columns.description: Credential classes a detector found in the output, for example api_key or private_key.
